description: This Java source file defines the GcmTransportCipher class, implementing encryption and decryption for network communication using GCM mode with HKDF key derivation. It includes nested classes for handling encryption and decryption handlers within a Netty pipeline, managing encrypted message transfer with segmenting and buffering.

classes.name: GcmTransportCipher
classes.description: Main class implementing network encryption/decryption using GCM with HKDF, integrating with Netty channels.

classes.name: GcmEncryptedMessage
classes.description: Handles encrypted message transfer, segmenting, buffering, and transfer over channels.

classes.name: DecryptionHandler
classes.description: Netty inbound handler for decrypting incoming encrypted data streams.

classes.name: EncryptionHandler
classes.description: Netty outbound handler for encrypting outgoing messages.

methods.name: getAesGcmHkdfStreaming
methods.description: Creates and returns an AesGcmHkdfStreaming object configured with the current key.

methods.name: getKeyId
methods.description: Returns the key ID for the current encryption key (testing purpose).

methods.name: getEncryptionHandler
methods.description: Creates a new encryption handler instance (testing purpose).

methods.name: getDecryptionHandler
methods.description: Creates a new decryption handler instance (testing purpose).

methods.name: addToChannel
methods.description: Adds encryption and decryption handlers to a Netty channel pipeline.
